//startCommand: Deliberately absent. The Dockerfile's CMD is the entrypoint, and it is the only place that knows the image layout. A startCommand here previously read 'node .next/standalone/server.js' — the path used to run the server from a repo checkout, not the path inside the image, where COPY .next/standalone ./ puts server.js at /app/server.js. It silently overrode the correct CMD and every container exited with MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
//cron:expire-clicks: 0 3 * * *  — GET /api/cron/expire-clicks with the CRON_SECRET bearer token. Deletes click events past the 90-day retention window (specifications/10-attribution.md §11). Retention that is documented but never executed is not retention.
